say:6:1621120004:1.text: I'm not here to argue. I... need some magic jelly. Can you help me out?
say:6:1621120004:1.source_cn: 我不是来跟你斗嘴的，来找你是想……想搞点甜甜冻，能帮个忙不？
say:6:1621120004:1.male: I'm not here to argue. I... need some magic jelly. Can you help me out?
say:6:1621120004:1.female: I'm not here to argue. I... need some magic jelly. Can you help me out?

say:7:1621120005:1.text: I'll pay. Whatever amount, just name it.

say:9:1621120006:1.source_cn: 你是跟我装傻还是怎么着？

say:10:1621120007:1.text: Anzel wants magical items. I don't have any left! What am I supposed to do? Rob someone?
say:10:1621120007:1.source_cn: 安泽要的是魔法道具，我现在手里根本没有了！难道去偷去抢吗？！

say:13:1621120010:1.text: This is rich. Someone who just crawled out of an interrogation room is now lecturing me on how to live?
say:13:1621120010:1.source_cn: 真是笑话，蹲过审查所的人，现在开始教我如何走路了？
say:13:1621120010:1.male: This is rich. Someone who just crawled out of an interrogation room is now lecturing me on how to live?
say:13:1621120010:1.female: This is rich. Someone who just crawled out of an interrogation room is now lecturing me on how to live?

say:14:1621120011:1.text: Do you have any idea how close I was to the final round?
say:14:1621120011:1.source_cn: 你知不知道那场面试，我原本能进最后一轮的。
say:14:1621120011:1.male: Do you have any idea how close I was to the final round?
say:14:1621120011:1.female: Do you have any idea how close I was to the final round?

say:15:1621120012:1.text: I prepared for months... Anzel only needed one assistant, and you dropped in from nowhere and took that spot. Do you know what that meant for me?
say:15:1621120012:1.source_cn: 我花了那么多时间准备……安泽只要一个人，结果你空降过来...
say:15:1621120012:1.male: I prepared for months... Anzel only needed one assistant, and you dropped in from nowhere and took that spot. Do you know what that meant for me?
say:15:1621120012:1.female: I prepared for months... Anzel only needed one assistant, and you dropped in from nowhere and took that spot. Do you know what that meant for me?

say:16:1621120013:2.text: Finn pauses, glances to the side, and lowers his voice.
say:16:1621120013:2.source_cn: 芬恩话音一顿，目光移向一旁，声音低了下去。
say:16:1621120013:2.male: Finn pauses, glances to the side, and lowers his voice.
say:16:1621120013:2.female: Finn pauses, glances to the side, and lowers his voice.

say:17:1621120014:0.text: I traded almost all my magical items for jelly. And one of them... was the oak staff my grandfather gave me.
say:17:1621120014:0.source_cn: 我几乎把所有魔力道具都拿去换甜甜冻了……可其中有一件，...
say:17:1621120014:0.male: I traded almost all my magical items for jelly. And one of them... was the oak staff my grandfather gave me.
say:17:1621120014:0.female: I traded almost all my magical items for jelly. And one of them... was the oak staff my grandfather gave me.

say:18:1621120015:0.text: I was so desperate to pass those early rounds that I traded it away too.
say:18:1621120015:0.source_cn: 为了能撑过前几轮考核，我连那根法杖都拿去换了。
say:18:1621120015:0.male: I was so desperate to pass those early rounds that I traded it away too.
say:18:1621120015:0.female: I was so desperate to pass those early rounds that I traded it away too.

say:19:1621120016:0.text: My plan was simple: become Anzel's assistant, earn his trust, get the staff back quietly, and walk away from this whole jelly mess...
say:19:1621120016:0.source_cn: 本想着等我当上安泽的助手，再把它悄悄夺回来，然后彻底远...
say:19:1621120016:0.male: My plan was simple: become Anzel's assistant, earn his trust, get the staff back quietly, and walk away from this whole jelly mess...
say:19:1621120016:0.female: My plan was simple: become Anzel's assistant, earn his trust, get the staff back quietly, and walk away from this whole jelly mess...

say:21:1621120018:1.text: Forget it. No point talking about it now.
say:21:1621120018:1.source_cn: 算了，现在这些话也没意义了。
say:21:1621120018:1.male: Forget it. No point talking about it now.
say:21:1621120018:1.female: Forget it. No point talking about it now.

say:22:1621120019:2.text: Finn lifts his head, and before he knows it, that cold look is back in his eyes.
say:22:1621120019:2.source_cn: 芬恩抬起了头，眼神不知不觉间，又回到了先前那副冷冷的模样。
say:22:1621120019:2.male: Finn lifts his head, and before he knows it, that cold look is back in his eyes.
say:22:1621120019:2.female: Finn lifts his head, and before he knows it, that cold look is back in his eyes.

say:23:1621120020:1.text: Don't worry. I won't come begging again.
say:23:1621120020:1.source_cn: 你放心，我不会再来求你第二次了。
say:23:1621120020:1.male: Don't worry. I won't come begging again.
say:23:1621120020:1.female: Don't worry. I won't come begging again.

choice:11:0:1.text: I don't understand why you're so obsessed.
choice:11:0:1.male: I don't understand why you're so obsessed.
choice:11:0:1.female: I don't understand why you're so obsessed.

say:25:1621120009:1.text: Stop? If I could, why do you think I'm begging you right now?
say:25:1621120009:1.source_cn: 别吃？我要是能做到，还来求你？
say:25:1621120009:1.male: Stop? If I could, why do you think I'm begging you right now?
say:25:1621120009:1.female: Stop? If I could, why do you think I'm begging you right now?

choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 那就别吃魔力甜甜冻了
